The function below (Kadane's algorithm) should return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of nums (nums may contain negative numbers, and is guaranteed non-empty). It has a bug that produces wrong answers when all numbers are negative. Fix it and return the complete corrected function.

def max_subarray_sum(nums):
    best = 0
    current = 0
    for n in nums:
        current = max(n, current + n)
        best = max(best, current)

tasks.prompt:
The function below merges two already-sorted lists into one sorted list. It has a bug that drops the last element of whichever list still has leftover elements after the main loop. Fix it and return the complete corrected function.

def merge_sorted(a, b):
    result = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(a) - 1 and j < len(b) - 1:
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            result.append(a[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(b[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(a[i:])
    result.extend(b[j:])
    return result
